population.source: hash-bound hydrated D0 source selection and new r1 runner artifacts

weights.conditioning: normalize original base weights globally within each explicitly reported eligible intersection
weights.missing_target_values: main target mean or G null; separate named available-case descriptor retains original weights
weights.unknown_qualification: report unknown mass and do not claim a completed target estimate
weights.zero_decision_game: retain game denominator and report no-observed-decision; not a fabricated zero state

accuracy.token_F1: whitespace-token multiset overlap; keep repeated-token counts
accuracy.reference: actual first observation after executing the cached draft in D, joined by bound state and physical group
accuracy.missing_policy: require usable nonblank raw prediction and qualified nonblank real reference before normalization; no replacement text or zero score
accuracy.prediction_unscoreable: text accuracy may remain available; excluded from confidence intersections
accuracy.shared_physical_groups: one accuracy observation per original state
accuracy.interpretation: text-match proxies, not semantic truth or probability calibration

scoring.exp_score: retain original wm_confidence_logprob for display and auditing; do not re-exponentiate to repair it
scoring.numeric_environment: CPython 3.10.21 for this offline acceptance; actual version recorded with every report
scoring.quantile_boundary: Fraction arithmetic on supplied binary float weights, then serialize fractional memberships as floats
scoring.tie_membership: all events with the identical score receive the same fractional membership at each boundary
scoring.top_half: same tie rule with two equal-weight bins, no outcome-based tie break
correlation: weighted Pearson of ordinary average ranks with exact ties

observed_effects.raw_Y_vs_qualification: retain raw Y separately even when inference or measurement qualification is pending
observed_effects.policy_content_failure: audited branch Y=0; retained source-draft failure has no local D/N/P event or utility
observed_effects.decomposition: check only on one common complete D/N/P set with identical weights

descriptive_rankings.prediction_length: number of tokens in the original aligned prediction_tokens_v2 span; longer first
descriptive_rankings.missing_auxiliary_score: unavailable on the common pool; do not drop points to create a different auxiliary pool
descriptive_rankings.G: sum normalized_w*(g-0.5)*observed_U, single-observation plug-in descriptor only
descriptive_rankings.constant_references: D/N/P means on the same complete pool; analytic Random G=0
descriptive_rankings.menu_global_contributions: use the global ranking and normalization; strata sum back to global G
descriptive_rankings.within_menu_reranking: separate conditional descriptor; never add it as if global contributions
descriptive_rankings.half_absolute_discordance: descriptive 0.5*mean(abs(Y_P-Y_D)), not true C or a valid upper confidence bound

case_selection.pool: all original D0-var planned points including source draft failures
case_selection.hash_input: namespace + newline + compact UTF-8 JSON [canonical_game_id,state_id], ensure_ascii=False; no seed
case_selection.sort: SHA256 hex ascending, then identity JSON string ascending
case_selection.rule: first not-yet-selected state in each category; first three require corresponding complete qualified outcomes
case_selection.absent_category: report absent; no additional collection or invented case

game_sensitivity.method: per-game weighted values and observed dispersion; leave one whole game out and recondition original weights
game_sensitivity.correlation: recompute means and ordinary average tie ranks after each game omission
game_sensitivity.rankings: recompute the common observed pool, global weights, exact ties and top-half probabilities after each game omission; report sensitivity only
game_sensitivity.constant_mean_or_less_than_two_contribut: range unavailable with explicit reason; per-game values retained
limits: not a latent utility or within-event noise estimate
does not solve common job dependence or Q5 coverage

behavior.unit: actual physical rollout; shared branches do not duplicate trajectories
behavior.mu_repeat: executed continuation action exactly equals immediately preceding executed action in that rollout
behavior.Nothing_happens: exact raw next_obs equals Nothing happens. on executed continuation transitions
behavior.partial_paths: retain and label validity; no population or causal explanation inferred
behavior.D_replay: all planned checks, actual transitions/new calls, first causal divergence and numeric findings
behavior.N_P_replay: separate-job receipts not supplied by this input; never infer passed
behavior.cached_boundary: adjacent mu repetition may compare first mu action to cached first action; longest streak includes cached first action
behavior.interrupted_journal: bind current_rollout raw evidence separately from completed groups; never promote an unfinished journal to a qualified outcome

costs.unit: unique original ledger file plus call ID, separate source and local scopes; one physical rollout per group
costs.unknown: retain known lower totals, mark unknown remainder, never silently fill zero

formal_G_C_analyzer: pending Q5 simulation and inference decisions
D1_size_selection: not automated by this descriptive report
